gameplayAdaptations: Walkable Jemaa el-Fnaa and Medina terrain is accurately flat/gently sloping across the Haouz Plain (~450-465 m ASL).
The High Atlas Mountains are NOT placed inside the city; they are represented only on the distant southern regional horizon boundary (+Z edge) to respect their true ~40-60 km relative distance.
